earnings.title: EQT Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Adjusted net income attributable to EQT (a) $ 261 $ 329 $ (68)
Cash Flow : Net cash provided by operating activities of $1,083 million; generated free cash flow attributable to EQT (1) of $283 million
outlook: Capital Expenditures : $638 million, 10 % below the low-end of guidance, driven by lower-than-expected upstream and midstream spending and continued benefit from operational efficiency gains
Operating Costs : Total per unit operating costs of $1.09 per Mcfe, at the low end of guidance driven by lower-than-expected LOE and production tax
The Company expects $540 – $610 million of maintenance capital expenditures in the fourth quarter of 2026.
Strategic growth capital expenditures in the fourth quarter of 2026 are expected to total $185 – $225 million.

items.heading: Drilling for, producing, gathering, transmitting, storing and processing natural gas are high-risk and costly activities with many uncertainties. Our future financial position, cash flows and results of operations depend on the success of our operating activities, which are subject to numerous risks beyond our control.
We are subject to risks associated with the operation of our wells, pipelines and facilities.

Significant portions of our assets have been in service for several decades. There could be unknown events or conditions, or increased maintenance or repair expenses and downtime, associated with our assets that could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, and cash flows.

Expanding our business by constructing new midstream assets subjects us to construction, business, economic, competitive, regulatory, judicial, environmental, political and legal uncertainties that are beyond our control.
A terrorist attack or armed conflict targeting our systems or natural gas infrastructure generally could materially adversely impact our operations.

Potential physical effects of climate change could disrupt our upstream, midstream and processing activities, cause us to incur significant costs in preparing for or responding to those effects, or otherwise adversely affect our business.
